notes.title: Announcing my new physics game!
notes.notes:
My newest project is called Mars First Logistics and it’s about delivering lots of awkwardly shaped cargo across a rugged open world using your own mechanical creations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33815408/17a5e019dffa0cc2242921f2baf81fea745b99c0.png[/img]

I’ve been enjoying the process of making this game. Instead of designing individual levels or puzzles, I’m making a set of toys and seeing what they’re like to play with in the game world, finding and exploring interesting interactions, with just enough direction so the player doesn’t feel lost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33815408/ae4f50e8b658367ba57a6c8650cd5edd7e6133fd.png[/img]

The game’s graphics are inspired by Lego instruction manuals. The simple black outlines and flat primary colours have a simultaneously playful and utilitarian vibe that I think suits the game. If it looks appealing, give it a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1532200/Mars_First_Logistics/]wishlist[/url] :)
